prompt: ねえ。剣道、やってるでしょ？　……　見ればわかるよ。私もそうだから。　……　えー、「さん」？ 同い年じゃん！ わかった、わかった。じゃあ、私は「なのは」って呼ぶね。いい？ どっちにしろ呼ぶけど。　……　私、そういうのができるほど、ひとつの場所にいたことないんだ。わかる？ 台所のどの引き出しがひっかかるか、知ってるような人。
style_alt: A 16-year-old Japanese high-school girl. Warm, bright and quietly confident; charismatic, friendly and a little playful, never loud. The last line is softer and a little wistful. Must sound like a teenager.
style_zephyr_bright: A 16-year-old Japanese high-school girl with a young, light, clear anime-heroine voice. Bright, sunny and quietly confident; playful and teasing, a smile in every line, never loud. The last line is softer and a little wistful. Must sound like a teenager, never a grown woman.
